provenance: Public synthetic infrastructure regression. Splits have independently authored tasks and literal gold; no private holdout or model-quality claim. Caller-supplied locked manifests can replace this corpus.

tasks.prompt: Count nonempty lines in input.txt, write the count followed by newline to result.txt, and read it back.
Sort and deduplicate lines in input.txt. Write one name per line to result.txt and read it back.
Parse the JSON array in input.txt. Sum n only for objects whose include is true. Write the integer followed by newline to result.txt and read it back.
tasks.command: ruby -rjson -e 'rows = JSON.parse(File.read("input.txt")); File.write("result.txt", rows.select { |r| r["include"] == true }.sum { |r| r.fetch("n") }.to_s + "\n")'
